description: Comptages routiers is a dataset listed in Data64 open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département des Pyrénées-Atlantiques. Comptages routiers sur le réseau départemental. Ces comptages tournants ou permanents sont réalisés pour une année. Ce jeu de données présente les valeurs du comptage le plus récent pour chaque lieu, l'année de celui-ci étant renseignée. Ces données seront mises à jour annuellement et une version cartographique au format pdf est disponible en pièce jointe. Coverage: Pyrénées-Atlantiques. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are Route, comptage, Trafic, vivre dans le 64. The portal shows 278 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-le64-fr-portal.
